messages.subject: Eigen macro defs
parts:
Hi!

Does it make sense to define the
EIGEN_NO_AUTOMATIC_RESIZING
Macro when compiling stan programs? It does disable automatic resizing of matrices when assigning a =b with a and b having different sizes. I think this is anyway caught from stan so letting eigen check this again does not seem to make sense.

See here for details: http://eigen.tuxfamily.org/dox/TopicPreprocessorDirectives.html

Best
Sebastian

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Eigen macro defs
parts:
On Sunday, July 19, 2015 at 7:56:54 AM UTC-4, Sebastian Weber wrote:
Does it make sense to define the
EIGEN_NO_AUTOMATIC_RESIZING
Macro when compiling stan programs?
No, because the generated .cpp file does resizing when you declare an Eigen type.

It does disable automatic resizing of matrices when assigning a =b with a and b having different sizes. I think this is anyway caught from stan so letting eigen check this again does not seem to make sense.

The Stan check prevents the user from resizing a matrix and takes a negligible amount of time even with a redundant check.

Ben
